extra_vocab.en: a large, formal dinner for many people
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司年度晚宴、頒獎典禮與飯店宴會的情境，是比 dinner 更正式、人數更多的聚餐。

example.en: Large banquets require careful planning and a detailed budget.
example.zh: 大型宴會需要仔細規劃和詳細的預算。

example.en: The banquet hall has a stage for speeches and music.
example.zh: 宴會廳有一個供演講和音樂表演用的舞台。

example.en: Our annual banquet is held every December downtown.
example.zh: 我們的年度宴會每年十二月在市中心舉行。

example.en: Each winner will receive a prize at the awards banquet.
example.zh: 每位得獎者都會在頒獎晚宴上領獎。

example.en: We plan to hold a banquet after the conference ends.
example.zh: 我們打算在研討會結束後舉辦一場宴會。

examples.en: The company is giving a big banquet to thank its best clients.
examples.zh: 公司舉辦一場盛大的宴會，感謝最好的客戶。

examples.en: The hotel can serve a banquet for up to three hundred guests.
examples.zh: 這間飯店最多可以為三百位賓客提供宴席。

examples.en: You are invited to the retirement banquet on Friday evening.
examples.zh: 誠摯邀請您參加星期五晚上的榮退宴會。

similar.diff: reception 是較輕鬆的酒會，常站著交談、時間較短；banquet 是坐下來用餐的正式宴會。

example.en: A short reception will be held before the main speech.
example.zh: 主要演說之前會有一場簡短的酒會。

example.en: The venue for the dinner has not been confirmed yet.
example.zh: 晚宴的場地還沒有確定。

example.en: The catering for the party will arrive at noon.
example.zh: 派對的外燴餐點中午會送到。

example.en: Each guest will receive a small gift at the door.
example.zh: 每位賓客在門口都會收到一份小禮物。

extra_vocab.en: the part of a building below the ground floor
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於辦公大樓、飯店與商店的設施介紹，例如停車場、儲藏室或機房位於地下室。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在地下室」用 in the basement，介系詞用 in，不用 at。

example.en: Some old basements need new lights and better air flow.
example.zh: 有些老舊的地下室需要新燈具和更好的通風。

example.en: Basement parking is free for visitors on weekends.
example.zh: 週末訪客可免費使用地下停車場。

example.en: The meeting rooms are on the basement level.
example.zh: 會議室位於地下樓層。

example.en: We rent basement storage for our seasonal products every winter.
example.zh: 我們每年冬天租用地下儲藏空間存放季節性商品。

examples.en: The old files are kept in the basement of our building.
examples.zh: 舊檔案存放在我們大樓的地下室。

examples.en: The hotel gym is located in the basement, next to the pool.
examples.zh: 飯店健身房在地下室，緊鄰游泳池。

examples.en: During the fire drill, everyone left the basement quickly.
examples.zh: 消防演練時，所有人都很快離開了地下室。

similar.diff: cellar 多指儲藏酒或食物的地下儲藏室；basement 是建築物的整層地下樓層。

example.en: The restaurant keeps its wine in a cool cellar.
example.zh: 餐廳把酒存放在涼爽的地窖。

example.en: The sales office is on the third floor.
example.zh: 業務辦公室在三樓。

example.en: Take the elevator down to the lobby, please.
example.zh: 請搭電梯到大廳。

example.en: We need more storage space for office supplies.
example.zh: 我們需要更多空間存放辦公用品。

derived.link: 基本字「底部」；base + -ment，「最底下的部分」，像 pay → payment

extra_vocab.en: a small object that gives power to a phone or a machine
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品說明、電子設備採購與出差情境，常談到電池壽命、充電與更換。

example.en: Please keep spare batteries in the supply cabinet for emergencies.
example.zh: 請把備用電池放在補給櫃裡以備不時之需。

example.en: Good battery life is important for people who travel often.
example.zh: 對常出差的人來說，良好的電池續航力很重要。

example.en: The scanner shows a low battery warning on the screen.
example.zh: 掃描器的螢幕上顯示電量不足的警告。

example.en: These devices come with a rechargeable battery and a charger.
example.zh: 這些裝置附有可充電電池和充電器。

examples.en: The remote control in the conference room needs a new battery.
examples.zh: 會議室的遙控器需要換新電池。

examples.en: This laptop uses a battery that lasts about ten hours.
examples.zh: 這台筆電使用的電池可以撐約十小時。

examples.en: Bring a power bank because my phone battery runs out fast.
examples.zh: 請帶行動電源，因為我的手機電量消耗得很快。

example.en: I left my phone charger in the hotel room.
example.zh: 我把手機充電器留在飯店房間了。

example.en: Please turn off all electronic devices during takeoff.
example.zh: 起飛時請關閉所有電子裝置。

example.en: The power went out in the office last night.
example.zh: 昨晚辦公室停電了。

extra_vocab.zh: 代表、利益（用於 on behalf of）
extra_vocab.en: used in phrases to say you act for another person or group
extra_vocab.note: behalf 幾乎只出現在 on behalf of 這個固定片語中，表示「代表某人或某組織」。在致詞、簽約、書信與電子郵件裡很常見，語氣正式有禮。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 固定用 on behalf of + 人／組織，或 on + 所有格 + behalf（on my behalf）；behalf 不能單獨使用，前面的介系詞用 on。

example.en: I am writing on behalf of the sales department.
example.zh: 我代表業務部門寫這封信。

example.en: Please accept the package on my behalf tomorrow.
example.zh: 請明天代我簽收這個包裹。

example.en: Only the director may sign on behalf of the company.
example.zh: 只有董事可以代表公司簽署。

examples.en: He gave a short thank-you speech on behalf of the staff.
examples.zh: 他代表全體員工發表了簡短的感謝致詞。

examples.en: The lawyer spoke to the court on his client's behalf.
examples.zh: 律師代表他的客戶向法院發言。

examples.en: On behalf of everyone here, I wish you a safe trip.
examples.zh: 我代表在場所有人，祝你一路平安。

confusable.diff: behalf 只用在 on behalf of；behave 是動詞，意思是「表現、舉止」，兩字拼法相近。

example.en: The staff must behave politely toward every customer.
example.zh: 員工必須對每位顧客保持有禮貌的態度。

similar.diff: representing 是動詞 represent 的分詞，後面直接接人或公司；on behalf of 是介系詞片語，後面也接人或公司。

example.en: She is representing our firm at the trade show.
example.zh: 她正代表我們公司參加商展。

example.en: A sales representative will visit your office on Tuesday.
example.zh: 一位業務代表星期二會到您的辦公室拜訪。

example.en: The manager must authorize every payment over one thousand dollars.
example.zh: 超過一千美元的款項都必須由經理授權。

example.en: The company spokesperson answered questions from reporters.
example.zh: 公司發言人回答了記者的提問。

extra_vocab.en: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於通勤、觀光、公司環保政策與市政建設的情境，口語常簡稱 bike。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「騎腳踏車去」用 by bicycle，bicycle 前面不加 a 或 the；指特定的一輛車才加冠詞。

example.en: The shop sells repaired bicycles at half the new price.
example.zh: 這家店以新車一半的價格販售整修過的腳踏車。

example.en: He likes to ride a bicycle along the river after work.
example.zh: 他下班後喜歡沿著河邊騎腳踏車。

example.en: The city built a new bicycle lane on Main Street.
example.zh: 市政府在主街上新建了一條自行車道。

example.en: The hotel offers bicycle rental for only ten dollars a day.
example.zh: 飯店提供租借腳踏車服務，一天只要十美元。

examples.en: Many employees come to the office by bicycle every day.
examples.zh: 許多員工每天騎腳踏車來上班。

examples.en: Tourists can see the old town on a guided bicycle tour.
examples.zh: 遊客可以參加導覽腳踏車行程遊覽老城區。

examples.en: The company gives each worker a bicycle to reduce traffic.
examples.zh: 公司給每位員工一輛腳踏車，以減少交通流量。

similar.diff: bike 是口語說法，較不正式；bicycle 在公告、報導或正式文件中較常見。

example.en: I usually take my bike to the office when it is sunny.
example.zh: 天氣晴朗時，我通常騎腳踏車去上班。

example.en: Riders must wear a helmet on all company bicycles.
example.zh: 騎乘公司的腳踏車一律要戴安全帽。

example.en: She commutes to work by train every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上搭火車通勤上班。

example.en: Please stay in your lane when you drive on the highway.
example.zh: 在高速公路上開車請保持在自己的車道。

extra_vocab.en: a large soft cover that keeps you warm
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於飯店、飛機與救援物資的情境，指「毛毯」。當形容詞時指「全面性的」，如 blanket ban（全面禁止）。

example.en: We donated fifty blankets to the local shelter last winter.
example.zh: 我們去年冬天捐了五十條毛毯給當地的收容所。

example.en: Please ask the front desk for an extra blanket.
example.zh: 請向櫃檯多要一條毛毯。

example.en: A warm blanket is on each seat for long flights.
example.zh: 長程航班的每個座位上都有一條保暖毛毯。

example.en: The store sells a soft wool blanket for thirty dollars.
example.zh: 這家店販售一條柔軟的羊毛毯，價格是三十美元。

examples.en: The hotel provides a clean blanket for every bed.
examples.zh: 飯店為每張床提供一條乾淨的毯子。

examples.en: The flight attendant offered each passenger a blanket and a pillow.
examples.zh: 空服員給每位乘客一條毯子和一個枕頭。

examples.en: Volunteers gave a blanket to every family after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，志工發給每個家庭一條毛毯。

confusable.diff: blanket 是「毛毯」；blank 是「空白的」，兩字拼法很像。

example.en: Please leave this line blank if it does not apply to you.
example.zh: 如果這一欄不適用於您，請留白。

example.en: Guests can ask for a softer pillow at the front desk.
example.zh: 客人可以向櫃檯要求更柔軟的枕頭。

example.en: The hotel changes the bedding every day.
example.zh: 飯店每天更換寢具。

example.en: Fresh towels are placed in every room each morning.
example.zh: 每天早上每間客房都會放置乾淨的毛巾。

example.en: She wrapped the glass in a blanket before shipping it.
example.zh: 她在寄送玻璃之前用毯子把它包起來。

example.en: The company announced a blanket ban on personal phone use.
example.zh: 公司宣布全面禁止使用私人手機。
